name: eight-hour-block-hourly-spacing-band-0175
rationale: Mandatory trading-cost hypothesis (16th consecutive negative static-mix run). 2026-10-13 lead #3: band 0.15 -> 0.20 cut only 5 trades @500k (14 -> 9) yet lost 0.9 of Sharpe, which suggested path dependence in which block-boundary target changes clear the band. 0.175 is the upper-side dose point between them; together with 0.125 it shows whether the 0.15 optimum is a stable peak. Diagnostic capitals carry the evidence; the band is inert below ~0.25 at 50,000 JPY.
